why: I compared each check's PASS and FAIL conditions with the words of its expect line. Checks 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 stay within their words. Check 1 requires "exactly two error lines" with non-empty error text, which follows from "prints <file>:<line>: <error> for every row". Check 6 rejects a pending workflow, which follows from "green". Check 4 breaks the criterion. Expect line 4 only asks for the package.json fields, no runtime dependencies, and node:test tests covering the listed cases. Check 4's PASS list adds "`npm test -w jsonl-lint` passes", and its FAIL rule ("FAIL if any of these is missing") applies to that item too. The words of line 4 don't require the tests to pass; that belongs to line 6, which covers root `npm test` and the workflow. This extra condition sits in PASS/FAIL instead of under Advisory, so the criterion is not met.
